references.text: The description of the south side of the courtyard with the same dimensions and materials as the north side, a hundred cubits long hangings with twenty pillars and twenty bases of bronze.
The use of bronze bases as foundations for the pillars, following the same construction principle as in the framework of the tabernacle.
The parallel account of the actual execution of the north side of the courtyard, with a hundred cubits of hangings, twenty pillars and twenty bases of bronze, as well as hooks and bands of silver.
All the pillars around the courtyard were to have bands of silver, the same detail mentioned here regarding the silver hooks and silver bands.
The use of gold hooks for the pillars, a similar construction element to the silver hooks used in the courtyard's pillars.
Confirms that the standard from 27:11 was followed for the entire courtyard; shows unity in obedience.
